name: airtable-exit
description: Move off Airtable onto your own CRM with almost no questions. /airtable-exit:setup detects your session and connectors, reads the base read-only (tables, automations, interfaces, people, usage), shows one plan to approve, then creates the repo, Supabase database and Vercel app on free plans, and installs the skills and knowledge base that run the migration.
